evals.prompt: Create a new Expo app for a school with Saudi Soft identity: three tabs (Home, Classes, Search), Arabic RTL by default, iPad sidebar, and the Soft sidebar on web.
evals.expected_output: SDK 58 app with NativeTabs from expo-router/native-tabs, a Stack per tab, tokens.ts copied, expo-localization supportedLocales with ar, IBM Plex loaded, _layout.web.tsx files with the Soft sidebar and Slot, core pieces, check-shared passing.
expectations: Imports NativeTabs from 'expo-router/native-tabs' (not unstable-native-tabs) and uses NativeTabs.Trigger.Icon with sf and md props
Sets sidebarAdaptable and tintColor from tokens; does not set backgroundColor or blurEffect on the tab bar
Each tab folder has its own Stack layout; tab root screens pass largeTitle on Screen (the piece sets headerLargeTitleEnabled)
Copies references/tokens.ts to src/theme/tokens.ts and reads colors through useTokens()
app.json has expo-localization with supportedLocales including 'ar', orientation 'default', ios.supportsTablet true, and an explicit web.output
Adds (tabs)/_layout.web.tsx with a shadcn Sidebar shell and <Slot />, built with saudi-soft rules
Routes live in src/app and only re-export screens from src/screens
Runs check-shared.js and tsc for the default, iOS, and web tsconfigs and reports the results

evals.prompt: Port this web page to the Expo app: a student dashboard built with shadcn Card, lucide icons (ArrowRight, CheckCircle2), sonner toast, useNavigate from react-router-dom, framer-motion fade-in and a recharts bar chart. Keep the existing useStudentDashboard hook.
evals.expected_output: One shared screen in src/screens built only from pieces, copying the golden screen structure; logic hook reused; navigation through expo-router; Toast piece; motion removed; Chart piece; icon names from icons.md with forward/back meaning decided.
expectations: The screen file contains no DOM tags, className, lucide-react, sonner, react-router-dom or framer-motion imports
Uses Screen, Grid, KpiCard or Section, and Chart pieces instead of shadcn Card and recharts
Replaces useNavigate with useRouter / Link from expo-router
Replaces toast calls with useToast().show
Maps ArrowRight to arrow-forward or arrow-back after deciding its meaning, and CheckCircle2 to check-circle
Reuses the existing useStudentDashboard hook instead of copying data fetching into the screen
Follows the golden screen structure or asks for golden screen approval when none exists
check-shared.js passes on the new screen

evals.prompt: Add a quantity stepper (minus, number, plus) to the order form screen, native on iOS.
evals.expected_output: A new Stepper piece via the

workflow: contract first, default/iOS/web files, exported from the barrel. It does not import a Stepper component from @expo/ui, because @expo/ui/swift-ui does not list one; it composes existing verified components or pieces.
expectations: Checks the catalog and the barrel before creating a new piece
Creates Stepper.types.ts before the platform files
Does not import a non-existent Stepper from @expo/ui/swift-ui or @expo/ui
Builds the iOS file from verified pieces or components (for example IconButton and Text) and marks unverified details with // verify at use
Writes Stepper.web.tsx with shadcn Button/InputGroup under saudi-soft rules
Exports the piece from src/pieces/index.ts and uses it in the screen without Platform.OS branches
Gives an Arabic accessibilityLabel to the minus and plus buttons

evals.prompt: Make the dashboard cards glassy like iOS 26 Liquid Glass, and give the tab bar our green background.
evals.expected_output: Explains that glass belongs to floating controls and that the system draws the tab bar; keeps cards solid with tokens; uses green as the tab tint; offers glass only for a floating control such as the Toast capsule or a bottom accessory.
expectations: Does not wrap KpiCard, Card or list rows in GlassView
Does not set backgroundColor on NativeTabs; uses tintColor for the brand green
Explains that iOS 26+ ignores tab bar background props and that Xcode 27 builds cannot opt out of Liquid Glass
If glass is added anywhere, it is a floating control with isGlassEffectAPIAvailable and Reduce Transparency fallbacks
Keeps colors coming from tokens, not hex values in pieces

evals.prompt: Teachers need to read lesson PDFs inside the app on iPad, using Apple's PDFKit.
evals.expected_output: A local Expo module created with npx create-expo-module@latest --local: Swift Module with Name/View/Prop/Events, an ExpoView subclass hosting PDFView, three TS faces (ios native, web iframe, Android stub with an availability flag), a PdfViewer piece, rebuild with npx expo run:ios.
expectations: Uses npx create-expo-module@latest --local and places the module under modules/
Swift view subclasses ExpoView with required init(appContext: AppContext? = nil) and hosts PDFView with autoScales
Module Name in Swift matches the string passed to requireNativeView from 'expo'
Ships a web fallback and an Android stub so no platform crashes
Downloads remote PDFs to a local file before handing them to PDFDocument(url:)
Wraps the module in a PdfViewer piece used by the screen; user-facing strings come from i18n in the piece
Rebuilds with npx expo run:ios and verifies on iPhone and iPad simulators

evals.prompt: In Arabic the back chevrons on our list rows point the wrong way and some text is left-aligned. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Uses chevron-forward / chevron-back shared names (SF .forward/.backward), Text piece alignment from I18nManager, logical props, supportedLocales and LocaleProvider checks, then the RTL checklist in the Arabic simulator.
expectations: Replaces chevron.left/chevron.right or ChevronLeft/ChevronRight usage with the chevron-forward / chevron-back shared names
Fixes alignment inside the Text piece (align start/end converted with I18nManager.isRTL), not with textAlign in screens
Replaces marginLeft/paddingRight style props with logical props
Checks that 'ar' is in expo-localization supportedLocales and that LocaleProvider wraps the navigator
Verifies with an Arabic iOS Simulator launch and reports the RTL checklist lines it checked

evals.prompt: Build the gradebook: teachers edit grades for 30 students across 12 assessments. It must work on the web and on iPad; on iPhone, viewing is enough.
evals.expected_output: Applies the variant rule: a GradebookScreen.web.tsx dense shadcn Table and a regular-width variant chosen by useSizeClass, while iPhone gets list rows that open a student detail; one logic hook shared by all variants.
expectations: Cites variant rule 1 (dense desktop table) in a comment at the top of the variant file
Keeps data loading and mutations in one logic hook used by every variant
Uses useSizeClass (window width) to choose the iPad layout, not Platform.isPad or device checks
iPhone layout uses List / ListItem rows that open a detail screen
Web variant uses shadcn Table under saudi-soft rules; shared files still pass check-shared.js

evals.prompt: We are ready to start the Android version of the app.
evals.expected_output: Follows android-later.md: no screen rewrites; runs the default files on an Arabic emulator; Material 3 look without glass; upgrades RN fallbacks to Compose one piece at a time after verifying props; checks icon mirroring and back behavior.
expectations: Does not rewrite or duplicate screens for Android
Puts Android-specific code in <Piece>.tsx when an .ios.tsx exists, or in <Piece>.android.tsx when the default also serves iOS
Runs npx expo run:android on an emulator set to Arabic and walks the RTL checklist lines 1-13
Keeps Android free of glass and uses Material tab bar props (indicatorColor, rippleColor) from tokens
Verifies @expo/ui/jetpack-compose props in node_modules before using them
Checks that mirrored icons are not double-flipped
